scope: Preserve responsive mobile position, x and y values from the Page Model through the public mobile fallback, with Save and Publish remaining separate.

finding.source: The mobile public fallback forced position:relative!important, left:0!important and top:auto!important on ordinary nodes, overriding Inspector values even though Canvas and Page Model retained them.
finding.resolution: The renderer emits mobile position/left/top CSS custom properties from the resolved responsive Page Model. Static and dynamically injected mobile fallback rules consume these variables with existing relative/zero/auto defaults.
